shorts_extract.hook: Two paintbrushes, a divider board, and 60 seconds: how Botvinick & Cohen (1998) proved your brain redraws the boundary of 'your body' in real time.
shorts_extract.core_experiment: Botvinick & Cohen (1998 Nature) synchronous brushing + proprioceptive drift, plus Ehrsson's premotor fMRI & sweat-spike threat proof.
shorts_extract.twist: Why a 500-ms brush delay or wooden block kills the spell, Lush's suggestibility critique vs physiological controls, and bionic limb embodiment.
